The complete-filter retention event is conditional inclusion only; reconstruction and verification remain part of the existing resource vector. review.scope: Targeted exact-edition success audit of the defining construction/parameter passages; not a new full-paper or forward-literature audit. Whole-attack, retention, local filtering and source sampling events remain distinct.

components.description: Source approximation exp(-2^ell), with ell=3.9 for this configuration. This is the wrong-subkey fraction used in the reconstruction cost, not the probability of recovering the true master key.

Conditional inclusion event only: a genuine target assignment cannot satisfy the forbidden impossible differential, hence cannot be removed by complete and correct evaluation of this filter. This source-construction consequence does not ensure a unique candidate, absence of implementation errors, or completion within an average cost.

Section6.2 Step4 models marking32-bit final-subkey assignments with2^(32+ell) suggestions. ell=3.9; exact formula inside the source random-marking model, not a proven independence bound or full recovery probability.
